### POST `/v1/projects/{projectId}/rate-limits`

**Create a rate-limit policy**

One policy per `(scope, resource_id)`, including the `resource_id: null` row that means "every resource in this scope". A non-null `resource_id` is resolved through the scoped repository for whatever the scope names, so another tenant’s endpoint is a 404.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `projectId` | path | string | yes |  | Project id, `proj_…`. Resolved from the project row, never trusted as a claim. |

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [CreateRateLimitDto](./schemas.md#createratelimitdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | yes | one of `organization`, `project`, `endpoint`, `ingest` | What the ceiling applies to. `endpoint` and `project` bound outbound delivery; `organization` bounds it across every project in the org; `ingest` bounds inbound event acceptance. |
| `resource_id` | string \| null | no | max 64 chars | The specific resource this limit covers, or null for EVERY resource in this scope. What it names depends on `scope`: an endpoint id, an API key id (`ingest`), this project’s id, or this organization’s id. It is resolved through the scoped repository for that table, so an id belonging to another tenant is a 404. |
| `limit` | number | yes | 1 to 10000000 | Requests allowed per window. Never 0 or negative: 0 would disable delivery or ingestion entirely for whatever this policy covers. |
| `window_seconds` | number | no | 1 to 86400; default `1` | Window length. Never 0: the refill rate is `limit / window`, so a zero window is a division by zero downstream. |
| `burst` | number \| null | no | 1 to 10000000 | Bucket capacity. Null means "the same as `limit`". When set it must be at least `limit`, or the bucket could never hold one window’s worth of tokens and the configured limit would be unreachable. |

#### Responses

**200 OK** - [RateLimitDto](./schemas.md#ratelimitdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `project_id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `scope` | string | yes | one of `organization`, `project`, `endpoint`, `ingest` |  |
| `resource_id` | string \| null | yes |  | Null means every resource in this scope. |
| `limit` | number | yes |  |  |
| `window_seconds` | number | yes |  |  |
| `burst` | number \| null | yes |  | Null means the same as `limit`. |
| `created_at` | string | yes |  |  |
| `updated_at` | string | yes |  |  |

### DELETE `/v1/projects/{projectId}/rate-limits/{policyId}`
